summary: Master debt recovery and sales strategies with our Microfinance Training Course. Boost your skills and enhance your career in the finance industry today!
lede: Debt collection training for microfinance teams covers arrears follow-up, portfolio risk, and responsible borrower sales. It is designed for credit, collections, loan, branch, and portfolio staff who need to prioritize overdue accounts, plan borrower contact, and track repayment performance. Participants practice aging and PAR analysis, repayment scheduling and escalation, collection communication, and branch recovery reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage repayment discipline, sales performance, and portfolio quality in microfinance operations. It suits people who need practical tools they can use in branch-level collections, borrower follow-up, and portfolio reporting.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of microfinance lending, basic credit administration, and borrower follow-up processes. You should be comfortable reading repayment schedules, arrears summaries, and branch portfolio reports; no programming or coding is required. Familiarity with loan officer work, collections routines, and basic Excel or spreadsheet use will help you get more from the exercises. Advanced portfolio analytics are introduced at operational level, while digital dashboard concepts are covered at overview level.
